scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build:check && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.format:check: npm run format:repo && npm --prefix apps/backend run format:check && npm --prefix apps/frontend run format:check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/backend run lint && npm --prefix apps/frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix apps/backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix apps/frontend run lint -- --fix
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/backend test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix apps/frontend test -- --run
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix apps/backend run test:e2e -- --runInBand && npm --prefix apps/frontend run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/frontend run typecheck
